```yaml
name: Termux Tests

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 0 * * 6"  # Weekly on Saturday
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  termux-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Setup QEMU for ARM emulation
      uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3
    - name: Run Termux tests in QEMU container
      run: |
        # Create a simple Dockerfile to build Termux environment
        cat > Dockerfile << 'EOF'
        FROM --platform=linux/arm64 ubuntu:22.04
        RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y wget gnupg
        RUN wget -qO - https://packages.termux.dev/apt/termux-main.gpg | apt-key add -
        RUN echo "deb https://packages.termux.dev/apt/termux-main stable main" > /etc/apt/sources.list
        RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y termux-tools
        RUN pkg update && pkg install -y python git
        RUN pip install --upgrade pip
        EOF
        
        # Build and run the container
        docker build -t termux-test .
        docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/app termux-test sh -c "
          cd /app &&
          pip install -r requirements.txt &&
          python run-all-tests.py -vv --no-pause --no-buffer
        "

  termux-test-full:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Setup QEMU for ARM emulation
      uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3
    - name: Run Termux tests with full requirements in QEMU container
      run: |
        # Create a simple Dockerfile to build Termux environment
        cat > Dockerfile << 'EOF'
        FROM --platform=linux/arm64 ubuntu:22.04
        RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y wget gnupg
        RUN wget -qO - https://packages.termux.dev/apt/termux-main.gpg | apt-key add -
        RUN echo "deb https://packages.termux.dev/apt/termux-main stable main" > /etc/apt/sources.list
        RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y termux-tools
        RUN pkg update && pkg install -y python git
        RUN pip install --upgrade pip
        EOF
        
        # Build and run the container
        docker build -t termux-test-full .
        docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/app termux-test-full sh -c "
          cd /app &&
          pip install -r requirements-full.txt &&
          python run-all-tests.py -vv --no-pause --no-buffer
        "

# Documentation: Both base and full requirements are tested in CI.
# The base requirements are tested in Latest-Run-All-Tests_Base.yml and Weekly-Run-All-Tests_Base.yml
# The full requirements are tested in Latest-Run-All-Tests_Full.yml and Weekly-Run-All-Tests-Full.yml
# This Termux workflow adds testing in a Termux container environment to ensure compatibility.
```
